name: Vietnamese Turkey "Banh Mi" Rice Bowl with Mixed Veggies (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 English cucumber
½ bunch radish
½ lime
½ small bunch cilantro
½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots. Quarter one carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Place on a plate. Coarsely grate remaining carrot and add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.

Trim and quarter one-third of the cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the plate with the carrot sticks and set aside. Small dice remaining cucumber and add to the bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl. Add fish sauce, mayo, and chili-garlic sauce, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 ½ tbsp mayonnaise
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Set aside for serving.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
454 g ground turkey
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KIDS PLATES: Divide a ½-cup of rice, a ½-cup of turkey, and veggie sticks between plates. Add a side of ranch dressing for dipping (if desired). 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice, turkey, and pickled veggies between bowls. Drizzle with lime sauce and sprinkle with herbs. Enjoy!
